episodes.title: Surviving a Cult & Rebuilding from Trauma with Beth Granger | Heart to Art Ep. 24
episodes.description:
On this episode of Heart to Art, host Peta-Gaye Nash sits down with author and cult survivor Beth Granger.

Together, they explore Beth’s 30-year journey inside the Grenville Christian College cult and her 16-year legal battle to reclaim freedom. She opens up about the painful process of writing her memoir, "Born and Razed: Surviving the Cult was Only Half the Battle." She shares powerful insights on rebuilding your life after extreme trauma.

Learn more about Beth Granger: https://bethgranger.ca/
Get her book, Born and Razed: https://bethgranger.ca/product/born-and-razed-surviving-the-cult-was-only-half-the-battle

About Heart to Art
Peta-Gaye Nash, Jamaican-Canadian author of Told Ya! Stories and Bushyhead, is fascinated by artists’ deepest motivations. This fascination has led to Heart to Art, a podcast where Peta-Gaye goes beneath the surface in conversations with artists about the hidden obstacles that have had a major impact on the way they create. Join her and her guests for engaging conversations that inspire, provoke, and resonate on both emotional and intellectual levels. Presented by Sauga Arts HUB.
